winning_patterns.action: Continue framing the 'self respect' narrative around physical or digital interface interactions that smartphone users perform daily.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'रात के ख्याल' and general 'ओवरथिंकिंग' without specific visual anchors (e.g., uIbMpCjVutQ with 6 views, WhJ-VwRa3Rg with 8 views) yield lower views.
